claims.statement: The STNFS algorithm of proof.md solves the full production bls12-381-fixed-g1-invert-g2 target with success at least 0.39 under the heuristics of proof.md section 9, with all classical work, preprocessing included, at most 2^120.522000 dense-Fp12 units (ledger: proof.md section 8).

experiments.purpose: Recomputes certificates, region, yield, cost, linear algebra, descent, ledger and every declared bound (about 10 s). Region metrics come from the hash-checked pool_summary.json; pool="full" regenerates all 19,765 pool rows and recomputes them (under 1 minute). quick=false adds the [6], [11], [11b], [12] audits.

Scaled two-sided special-q descent with the production rules; measures node failure / NB model, retry ratio and between-table boot variance (DESCENT.md, dependence margins). The quoted figures use tables=72, workers=8, boot_rels=150 (offline, about 3 min on 8 cores); smaller inputs run single-process in the sandbox.
